slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
A self-similar figure is made of smaller copies of itself.

The Koch curve replaces each segment with 4 segments, each 1/3 as long. So each stage multiplies the length by 4/3, and after n stages the length is (4/3)n times the original, growing without bound. The Sierpinski triangle is made of 3 copies scaled by 1/2, so its area is multiplied by 3/4 at each stage.
